description: Create an e-signature request record: document reference, signer list, per-signer pending status, expiry, and an approval hook. Signatures complete only in the human loop — this module never reports a signature it did not see.
name: esign_request
provider_notes: Local signing-request ledger via ctx.memory (key aul:esign_requests_v1). Creating a request is an external send (invitations go to the signers), so it requires ctx.approval_request first ($0.01 human-approval push). Signature completion happens in the human loop outside this module; status stays pending_signature until cancelled. No e-sign provider integrated.
